title: Heaven on Earth
author: May Manoj
text:
You cry, laugh, feel, smile;
Do a lot that`s worthwhile
Because you`re a magical being,
Truly mystical human being.

You make everyday count;
Every moment without discount
Because you know life`s precious,
Everything`s auspicious.

Kindness, matchless as no other;
Like that of a mother or brother.
This gift of caring for each other,
Is the best, mankind has ever!

At times, it`s true we fall
From divine attributes and all;
Yet, that`s what makes us human,
Humble men and women.

We see in each other wisdom,
Forgiveness, care and freedom.
Through each virtue we give,
A heaven on earth we live!
